messages:
Anya: quick profiling ask — seeing ~30% token latency regression on prod d-1. Can someone run an nsys trace + torch.profiler on a representative workload (1–2 min warmup + 60s steady)? Need flamegraph + NVTX ranges.
Sam: got it. which host/queue? dedicated perf-gpu-02 or can i run on my dev box?
Liam: perf-gpu-02 (p4d) eu-west is best — same kernel/driver as prod. avoid shared nodes. Use `--capture-range=nvtx` so we can isolate model forward.
Anya: recommended nsys command:
```
nsys profile -o /tmp/trace -t cuda,osrt --sample=cpu --time-unit=ns --capture-range=nvtx --force-overwrite --stats=true --trace-fork-before-exec=true --sleep-before=2 --sleep-after=2 --duration=60 --sample-freq=1000 --python python run_inference.py --config prod_small
```
Also torch.profiler snippet:
```
with torch.profiler.profile(activities=[torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CPU, torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CUDA],
                               schedule=torch.profiler.schedule(wait=10, warmup=10, active=30),
                               record_shapes=True,
                               profile_memory=True,
                               with_stack=True) as p:
    for step, batch in enumerate(loader):
        out = model(batch)
        p.step()
```
DevOps QA: please redact any PII before uploading. Keep trace <= 2GB; if larger, use `nsys export --format sqlite` and share that. Also add `--trace-duration`/`--duration` and run with `--capture-range=nvtx` to shrink size.
perf-bot: Upload accepted: https://storage.redwood-inference/traces/1749001234-nsys.tgz (expires in 7d). Max size 2GB. Use `perf-bot upload /tmp/trace*` for automated metadata collection.
Sam: after we get the flamegraph we'll diff vs last-known-good (commit abc123) with `perf-diff --left abc123 --right HEAD --flamegraph` — helps pinpoint op regressions.
Liam: FYI to get aten/op-level names enable `with_stack=True` in profiler and set `torch.autograd.set_detect_anomaly(False)` to reduce noise.
Anya: running now at 09:30 PT. I'll post the speedscope/flamegraph link when converted. Thanks :thumbsup: 
Anya: uploaded s3://redwood-traces/1749001234-nsys.tgz — link is the perf-bot URL above.
